Broadcom (AVGO) grew annual revenue 2.3x in 4 years. What do the numbers say about that growth, and what don’t they say?

Latest fiscal year: FY2025 (ended Nov 2, 2025)
• Revenue: $63.9B (+23.9% YoY)
• Operating margin: 39.9%
• Net margin: 36.2%
• Free cash flow: $26.9B (42.1% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Aug 2, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $29.6B (+85.5% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 53.9%

4-year view (FY2021 → FY2025)
• Revenue: $27.4B → $63.9B (2.3x; compound annual growth 23.5%)
• Operating margin: 31.0% → 39.9% (+8.9 pts)
• Free cash flow: $13.3B → $26.9B
• Cash conversion: operating cash flow was 119.1% of net income
• Year that stands out: FY2024, operating margin 26.1%, revenue growth +44.0%
